Alpha-Omega is a dichotomy between [[Alpha]] and [[Omega]]. It is similar to the dichotomy between [[Overseer]] and [[Underseer]] since Lambda is self interacting while Alpha and Omega interact with each other

It is linked to the [[Narrative Order]]
